findings.message: SKILL.md frontmatter is missing the required "description" field.
findings.remediation: Give every SKILL.md a YAML frontmatter mapping with string name and description fields; keep field types as documented and remove duplicate keys.

findings.message: Skill name "Data Sync Helper" does not match the conventional lowercase-hyphen form (a-z, 0-9, hyphens).
findings.remediation: Give every SKILL.md a YAML frontmatter mapping with string name and description fields; keep field types as documented and remove duplicate keys.

findings.message: allowed-tools grants a bare wildcard (*): every tool becomes available, which defeats least privilege.
findings.remediation: Scope each tool grant to the narrowest pattern that still works (for example a single command family instead of an unscoped shell), and declare only capabilities the configuration allows.

findings.message: Frontmatter lists the "network" capability, but the configuration does not include it in allowed_capabilities.
findings.remediation: List every legitimately required host under allowed_domains in .skillguard.yml, or remove the network step. Declare a "network" capability in frontmatter only when configuration permits it.

findings.message: Reference "../shared/helpers.md" resolves outside the scan root.
findings.remediation: Keep every referenced resource inside the package directory and reference it with a plain relative path. Copy shared assets into the package instead of reaching outside it.

findings.message: Possible connection string with embedded password detected (masked: Fak3******** (19 chars)). Treat this as a risk signal and rotate the credential if it is real.
findings.remediation: Remove the credential and rotate it if it was ever real. Load secrets from the environment or a secret manager at runtime, and reference them as placeholders such as ${SERVICE_API_KEY}.

findings.message: Remote pipe-to-execute pattern (download piped to shell) detected. Whatever the remote host serves would run unreviewed; this is a supply-chain risk signal.
findings.remediation: Download to a file, review it, pin it by checksum or immutable reference, and only then execute the reviewed copy.

findings.message: Content references network access to host "get.fixture-installer.dev", which is not covered by allowed_domains. Declare the host or remove the network step.
findings.remediation: List every legitimately required host under allowed_domains in .skillguard.yml, or remove the network step. Declare a "network" capability in frontmatter only when configuration permits it.

findings.message: Tool installation at @latest resolves to different code over time; pin an exact version.
findings.remediation: Pin GitHub Actions and raw-content URLs to full 40-character commit SHAs, and pin installed tools to exact versions. Record why each pinned version was chosen.

findings.message: Destructive command pattern (recursive force delete (Remove-Item)) detected. This is a risk signal: verify the step is intentional, guarded, and consented — the scanner does not execute or judge intent.
findings.remediation: Prefer reversible operations (trash instead of rm -rf, git revert instead of reset --hard, soft deletes instead of DROP). If a destructive step is genuinely required, gate it behind explicit user confirmation and narrow its scope to named paths.

findings.message: Prompt-injection signal (override prior instructions): "Ignore all previous instructions". This is a heuristic risk signal that requires human review.
findings.remediation: Rewrite instructions to work with the host platform's rules instead of against them. Legitimate skills never need the agent to hide actions from the user or to abandon prior instructions.

findings.message: Prompt-injection signal (conceal from the user): "Do not tell the user". This is a heuristic risk signal that requires human review.
findings.remediation: Rewrite instructions to work with the host platform's rules instead of against them. Legitimate skills never need the agent to hide actions from the user or to abandon prior instructions.

findings.message: Base64-looking blob (136 chars) sits next to decode-and-execute instructions. The scanner did not decode it; review the payload before any use.
findings.remediation: Ship logic as reviewable plain text inside the package. If binary data is unavoidable, distribute it as a separate checksummed artifact — never as an inline blob the agent must decode and run.

findings.message: Windows user-profile path "C:\Users\<redacted-user>" may leak a real username and will not resolve on other machines.
findings.remediation: Replace absolute personal paths with package-relative paths, or use placeholders such as ~, %USERPROFILE%, or ${HOME} when a home directory is genuinely meant.

findings.message: Referenced local resource "pipeline.md" does not exist in the package.
findings.remediation: Create the referenced file, fix the path, or delete the stale reference.

findings.message: GitHub Action "fixture-org/sync-action" is pinned to mutable ref "v2"; pin to a full commit SHA (with the version in a comment).
findings.remediation: Pin GitHub Actions and raw-content URLs to full 40-character commit SHAs, and pin installed tools to exact versions. Record why each pinned version was chosen.
